about_the_game:
Demo scope:

  • 20-40 minutes of polished gameplay

  • a glimpse into the dark background scenario

  • Languages: English, German, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Turkish

It is completely okay to stream the demo or generate content from it - please link to its Steam page for wishlisting.

Tackle for Loss is a 2D top-down action game that puts you in the shoes of a former American football pro. Violent combat, a captivating narrative, and dark pixel art combine to create a pumped-up experience, inspired by the likes of "Hotline Miami". The player is haunted by the lingering effects of concussions and driven by a desperate mission to save a loved one. Utilizing his unique set of football skills, players will navigate a gritty underworld, battling enemies and unraveling a conspiracy in the process.

  • Football Infused Combat

  • Killstreak Mechanic

  • Unlockable Skillpath

  • Gamepad & Keyboard Support

  • Gritty Backstory

  • Languages: English, German, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Turkish

TACKLE: Move through enemy lines like a knife through butter and rack up killstreak points.

SPIKE: Grab your enemies with a lethal grip and smash them into pieces with this melee attack.

PIGSKIN: Use your deadly precision in this ranged attack.

SKILLPATH: Rapidly eliminating enemies extends combo chains and increases score multipliers, rewarding players for aggressive and strategic gameplay. Unique moves and attacks can be unlocked through progression. By experimenting with a variety of skills and perks, players can develop and refine a variety of combat styles.

Tackle for Loss is a game solo-developed by Indifferent Penguin / Daniel Wichterich. That means I am the only person working full-time on this game. During development, I’ve been fortunate to meet people who have contributed in meaningful ways, whether through their creative work, valuable feedback, or support. Here’s a list of those incredible contributors—a list that is still growing:

  • Nik Neumetzler – Key Art

  • Riccardo Berndt – Additional Pixel Art

  • BaerSerker-Art – Public Relations

Funded by Medienboard Berlin-Brandenburg.

content_descriptors.notes: Depiction of violence and blood in retro pixel art
